passRule: A case passes when every 'must' check passes. Flag checks must hold on every run; other checks on at least ceil(2/3 of runs). Errored runs count as failures. 'ideal' checks are reported but never fail a case.

backingLegend.code: Enforced deterministically by lib/ai/evaluate.ts once the model emits the upstream signal (flag or 'unanswered' status). Failure = model missed the signal, or a code regression.
backingLegend.prompt: Depends only on the model following the prompt rubric. Failure = evaluator judgment problem.
